credentialsIntro: PaperHub calls LLM providers through LiteLLM using your own API keys. Add a key as a name/value pair — the name is the provider's environment variable (e.g. OPENAI_API_KEY) and the value is the secret. Values are stored locally on this server.
credentialsDocsLink: See LiteLLM's provider list for the exact key name and where to get each key
modelUnusable: This model isn't usable — check that the model name is available and the API key is valid.
modelUnreachable: Couldn't reach the provider just now — this is usually transient, try again.
modelNoTools: This model can't call tools, which every chat turn needs — pick a model with tool (function) calling.

welcome.title: Welcome to PaperHub
welcome.subtitle: Connect a model provider to start chatting. Finish these steps in Settings:
welcome.lockNote: The composer stays locked until all three are valid.
welcome.lockedStep: Set by the deployer in backend/.env. Ask them to fix it.
welcome.optionalSS: Optional: add a Semantic Scholar API key in Settings → Integrations for faster paper search (the free tier is rate-limited; it won't block anything).

credential.label: Add a provider API key
credential.help: e.g. GEMINI_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY, under Models & providers.

small.label: Set a valid Small-tier model
small.help: Used for classifiers and fast tool calls.

PAPERHUB_MODEL_SMALL.label: Small-tier model
PAPERHUB_MODEL_SMALL.help: Default for classifiers / fast tool calls.

PAPERHUB_ROUTER_MODEL.label: Router model
PAPERHUB_ROUTER_MODEL.help: Picks the intent for each turn (chitchat / paper_search / paper_qa / slides …). Defaults to the small tier.

PAPERHUB_CHITCHAT_MODEL.label: Chitchat model
PAPERHUB_CHITCHAT_MODEL.help: Small-talk replies when the router picks chitchat. Defaults to the small tier.

PAPERHUB_PAPER_QA_MODEL.label: paper_qa finalizer
PAPERHUB_PAPER_QA_MODEL.help: Cross-paper answer synthesis, streamed to you. Defaults to the flagship tier.

PAPERHUB_PAPER_QA_SUBAGENT_MODEL.label: paper_qa subagent
PAPERHUB_PAPER_QA_SUBAGENT_MODEL.help: Per-paper section navigation + chunk selection. Defaults to the small tier.

PAPERHUB_SQL_AGENT_MODEL.label: SQL agent
PAPERHUB_SQL_AGENT_MODEL.help: library_stats ReAct agent (reason → query → curate → answer). Defaults to the small tier.

PAPERHUB_MEMORY_CONFLICT_MODEL.label: Memory conflict detector
PAPERHUB_MEMORY_CONFLICT_MODEL.help: Checks whether a new memory contradicts an existing one. Defaults to the small tier.

PAPERHUB_TRANSLATE_MODEL.label: Translation model
PAPERHUB_TRANSLATE_MODEL.help: Translates papers for bilingual reading. Defaults to the small tier.

PAPERHUB_FEEDBACK_REVIEW_MODEL.label: Feedback reviewer
PAPERHUB_FEEDBACK_REVIEW_MODEL.help: Checks whether a flagged answer was really wrong. Defaults to the flagship tier.

PAPERHUB_IDEATION_CARD_MODEL.label: Mechanism card builder
PAPERHUB_IDEATION_CARD_MODEL.help: Summarises each document's problem and mechanism for ideation. Defaults to the small tier.

PAPERHUB_IDEATION_MODEL.label: Ideation model
PAPERHUB_IDEATION_MODEL.help: Proposes cross-domain ideas from the mechanism cards. Defaults to the flagship tier.

PAPERHUB_REPORT_RESOLVE_MODEL.label: Slide resolver
PAPERHUB_REPORT_RESOLVE_MODEL.help: Resolves enabled papers + classifies deck commands. Defaults to the small tier.

PAPERHUB_REPORT_NOTES_MODEL.label: Slide notes author
PAPERHUB_REPORT_NOTES_MODEL.help: Writes the deck's speaker notes. Defaults to the flagship tier.

PAPERHUB_REPORT_PLAN_MODEL.label: Slide agent
PAPERHUB_REPORT_PLAN_MODEL.help: Per-paper gather-context + the slide agent. Defaults to the flagship tier.

PAPERHUB_REPORT_SECTION_MODEL.label: Slide single-frame edit
PAPERHUB_REPORT_SECTION_MODEL.help: Single-frame slide / title / preamble edits. Defaults to the flagship tier.

PAPERHUB_TRANSLATE_FULL_PAPER.label: Translate the whole paper
PAPERHUB_TRANSLATE_FULL_PAPER.help: After the visible part, translate the rest of the paper in the background.

PAPERHUB_FEEDBACK_REVIEW.label: Review corrections and forks
PAPERHUB_FEEDBACK_REVIEW.help: Ask a reviewer agent whether a correction-like message, or forking a turn, means the previous answer was wrong.

PAPERHUB_FEEDBACK_KEYWORDS.label: Correction keywords
PAPERHUB_FEEDBACK_KEYWORDS.help: Comma-separated words that flag the previous answer for review. Blank uses the built-in Chinese / English / Japanese list.

PAPERHUB_IDEATION_PROBLEM_THINKING_BUDGE.label: Ideation reasoning budget (problem mode)
PAPERHUB_IDEATION_PROBLEM_THINKING_BUDGE.help: Caps the reasoning tokens of each idea proposal for a problem. 0 = no cap. Free exploration is never capped.

PAPERHUB_MEMORY_RECALL.label: Inject recalled memories
PAPERHUB_MEMORY_RECALL.help: Surface active memories to answering agents.

PAPERHUB_SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY.label: Semantic Scholar API key
PAPERHUB_SEMANTIC_SCHOLAR_API_KEY.help: Optional but recommended — speeds up paper search. The unauthenticated tier is heavily rate-limited (it won't block the app, just slow searches).

PAPERHUB_UNPAYWALL_EMAIL.label: Unpaywall contact email
PAPERHUB_UNPAYWALL_EMAIL.help: Enables the DOI→free-PDF fallback. Used for abuse logging only.

PAPERHUB_WORKSPACE.label: Workspace directory
PAPERHUB_WORKSPACE.help: Set via env var at boot; restart the backend to change.

PAPERHUB_AGENT_MODEL.label: Core agent
PAPERHUB_AGENT_MODEL.help: The tool-calling agent that answers every chat turn. Defaults to the flagship tier.

PAPERHUB_AGENT_GATHER_MODEL.label: Agent context gatherer
PAPERHUB_AGENT_GATHER_MODEL.help: Reads papers for the core agent's gather tools. Defaults to the small tier.

PAPERHUB_AGENT_AUTOAPPROVE_MODEL.label: Agent auto-approver
PAPERHUB_AGENT_AUTOAPPROVE_MODEL.help: Judges whether an action the agent proposes matches what you asked. Defaults to the small tier.

PAPERHUB_OUTBOUND_REVIEW.label: Review outbound searches
PAPERHUB_OUTBOUND_REVIEW.help: Rewrites or holds a query that would reveal your private documents, notes or experiments.

PAPERHUB_OUTBOUND_UNSURE.label: When the review isn't sure
PAPERHUB_OUTBOUND_UNSURE.help: Ask me before sending, or never send it.

PAPERHUB_SENSITIVE_TERMS.label: Sensitive terms
PAPERHUB_SENSITIVE_TERMS.help: Never sent anywhere: product names, project names, customers. Matched without case.

PAPERHUB_PRIVATE_UPLOAD_DEFAULT.label: New uploads are private
PAPERHUB_PRIVATE_UPLOAD_DEFAULT.help: Ticks "private document" on the upload form by default. You can still untick it for a public paper.

PAPERHUB_TRUSTED_SEARCH_URL.label: Trusted search service
PAPERHUB_TRUSTED_SEARCH_URL.help: Your organisation's search service. Queries stay on your network.

PAPERHUB_PUBLIC_WEB_SEARCH.label: Public web search
PAPERHUB_PUBLIC_WEB_SEARCH.help: Bing, DuckDuckGo and other public engines. Finds more, including new and trending work.

PAPERHUB_OUTBOUND_ALLOWLIST.label: Allowed destinations
PAPERHUB_OUTBOUND_ALLOWLIST.help: Hosts PaperHub may contact. Anything else is blocked.

PAPERHUB_OUTBOUND_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS.label: Keep entries for
PAPERHUB_OUTBOUND_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS.help: How long outbound log entries are kept (at least 7 days).

PAPERHUB_OUTBOUND_REVIEW_MODEL.label: Review model
PAPERHUB_OUTBOUND_REVIEW_MODEL.help: Model that judges each outbound request. Leave empty to use the small tier.

PAPERHUB_OUTBOUND_REVIEW_TIMEOUT.label: Review timeout (seconds)
PAPERHUB_OUTBOUND_REVIEW_TIMEOUT.help: How long to wait for the review before the unsure policy applies.
